text:
Mats Zuccarello is 39, played 452 games in Minnesota, and is now in Los Angeles, trying to help a team that has struggled to score. He missed time early and has four points in 12 games, three of them goals, with two in his last week. NHL.com's insider note said he and Kevin Fiala are making strides in their returns.

Our numbers say be patient but realistic. The Kings take 45% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), almost six points worse than without him, and the team has scored a little more than its chances with him out there. He has always been a passer more than a shooter, and one assist in 12 games is not who he is; Evolving-Hockey had him 73rd among all forwards last season. Undrafted, he has built a 963-game career on vision. Our range has him around 44 points. Watch whether the assists start to come.
